item.description: A kids soccer game in Kansas devolved into chaos when a black pickup truck plowed onto the field killing two people and injuring 10. Investigators say a 34-year-old woman was taken into custody and released pending toxicology results and a mechanical examination of the truck. They have not publicly named or charged the driver. NBC’s Maggie Vespa reports for TODAY.

media:content.media:description: A protestor holds a sign reading "Generations 6-7 redoes May 68" in front of a fire at the Boulevard des Capucines during a demonstration to protest against the "high cost of living", in Paris on October 17, 2026 as part of a nationwide call for mobilisation bringing together various groups expressing their anger: former "Yellow Vests", secondary school and university students, climate activists and even farmers

media:content.media:credit: Eff Pachoud; Dimitar Dilkoff; Geoffroy Van Der Hasselt
